recorded_at: inversion slice (FR-019) — re-recorded per quickstart Scenario 2; replaces the milestone's pre-inversion values
method: Screenshots of the published bundle (dist/, served via nginx) at fixed camera (center [8.52, 49.5], zoom 12, 1280x800), buildings-fill hidden (style variant with buildings layers visibility:none; identical main.js and style.json layers otherwise). Slider driven via the DOM input event. Central 50% crop (mask/black excluded via luminance > 0.01). Headless Chromium screenshot pipeline writes the WebGL framebuffer (linear) raw into the PNG without the sRGB encode, so PNG bytes are treated as linear directly (verified: def/max per-pixel ratio = 0.6504 recovers 0.65 exactly; the milestone's real-browser pipeline was sRGB-encoded and its recorded 0.661 matches the same transfer).

sc001_background_luminance_gate.criterion: min background p10 <= 10% of default background p10 (feature pixels excluded)
sc001_background_luminance_gate.expected: 0.05/0.65 = 0.077 pure-dimming floor; inverted background (1 - 0.95 tile) adds ~0.05 linear, measured p10 0.039

sc001_max_restores_original.gate: PASS (matches milestone's 0.661 and the 65/100 paint mapping)
sc001_max_restores_original.note: def/max = 0.6504 confirms the slider identity mapping v/100 reaches raster-brightness-max linearly (65 -> 0.65x of the 100 rendering)

sc008_inversion_legibility.criterion: per-pixel: mean luminance at min of features (dark at max, below p25) > mean luminance at min of background
sc008_inversion_legibility.gate: PASS (0.173 > 0.130; streets/labels render lighter than the near-black background)

fr019_grayscale.gate: PASS (inversion is exactly grayscale; no hue shift)

fr003_no_regression_on_load.criterion: real bundle at slider 65 vs pre-inversion bundle (9a00fcd style.json) at 65, buildings visible, same camera
fr003_no_regression_on_load.gate: PASS (pixel-identical; the hidden basemap-inverted layer contributes nothing at s = 0)

fr019_crossfade_progression.criterion: gradual transition below 25, no sudden switch (background p10, raw linear)
fr019_crossfade_progression.gate: PASS (monotonic, smooth ramp; features brighten 0.12->0.17 mean as inversion completes)

per_pixel_multiplier_secondary.note: min_vs_default median is NOT comparable to the milestone's 0.09: inversion (FR-019) deliberately brightens background pixels (photo-negative, out = 1 - in) instead of continuing to dim them. The SC-001 gate is the p10-based check above (PASS).
